title: Google Drive 'Add shortcut' into another account's folder fails silently
symptoms: Dialog accepts, spinner runs, nothing is created
cause: Link-based edit access to a folder owned by another account is not enough to create a shortcut in it. The same shortcut into your own My Drive works at once.
fix: Do the work from the account that owns the destination, after the source is shared with it. Verify sharing with the permissions API rather than the share dialog.
apply: GET https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/{fileId}/permissions and confirm the expected account is listed
